newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends narrowly mixed.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed narrowly mixed, with commercials featured trading the December/March spread, traders said.
Continental Grain was noted buying 800,000 bushels of December/March and Atwood-Larson bought a similar amount of March/December, they said.
Wilson Trading bought about 600,000 bushels of March late after earlier selling about 1.2 million. ADM bought 400,000 to 500,000 of March early.
No deliveries against December spring wheat futures was supportive to December. Deferreds were pressured by lower CBOT soft red winter wheat futures.

MGE spring wheat futures trading closed at 1210 CST/1810 GMT due to Thursday's U.S. Thanksgiving holiday. Contracts closed up 2-1/2 cents to down 6-1/2 cents, with December up 2-1/2 at $4.23 a bushel and March down 5-1/2 at $3.81-1/2.
Normal trading hours of 0930 CST to 1315 CST resume Monday.
